hook: It's not just hard to be poor. It's expensive. People with the least money often pay the most for the same things. In this video I go through 20 hidden costs of being poor from three angles: banking and borrowing (overdrafts, check cashing, 400% payday loans), time and mental bandwidth (the boots theory, the time tax), and a step-by-step plan to escape the poverty premium.
shorts: It's expensive to be poor. Here's the proof.
The boots theory: why cheap things cost more
How to escape the poverty premium, step by step
Same income, $2,000 a year difference. Here's why.
